paper_title: Generating Diverse Training Samples for Relation Extraction with Large   Language Models
caption: Average repetition rate of words between generated training samples (K=32) for each relation category.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the mean interclass similarity across different relation categories. The x-axis is labeled "Relation Category" and has a linear scale, ranging from approximately 0 to 60 with tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "Average Repetition Rate" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.6 with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains three primary lines. The first line is blue with circle markers and a solid style, representing "w/o DPO obo". It starts with a mean interclass similarity of slightly above 0.2 at 0 relational category, peaking around 0.6 at the 1st and 31st category, and fluctuates across the axis, ending below 0.1 at 64th category. The second line is orange with triangle markers and a solid style, representing "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint". It starts just about 0.16, peaks with the highest point around 0.6 near the 31st category, and ends about 0.16 at 64th category. The third line is green with square markers and a solid style, showing "DPO". This line begins near 0.117 and has fluctuations along the axis, peaks with the highest point around 0.6 near the 31st category, ending just above the blue line and below the orange line. Additionally, there are three horizontal dashed lines representing average values: one orange at 0.227, one blue at 0.163, and one green at 0.117. All the line a multiple points intersect each other. A legend is given top left describing the line and its color.

Die Abbildung ist ein Liniendiagramm und veranschaulicht die durchschnittliche Ähnlichkeit zwischen Klassen über verschiedene Relationskategorien hinweg. Die horizontale Achse ist beschriftet mit "Relation Category" und verwendet eine lineare Skala von 0 bis 70. Die Teilstriche sind im Abstand von 10 angeordnet. Die vertikale Achse trägt die Bezeichnung "Mean Interclass Similarity" und verwendet eine lineare Skala mit einem Bereich von 0.0 bis 0.5 und Teilstrichen im Abstand von 0.1. Das Diagramm besteht aus 3 gestrichelten und 3 durchgezogenen Linien jeweils in blau, orange und grün. Die durchgezogenen Linien haben ein ZigZag Muster mit Werten zwischen 0.1 und 0.5. Die gestrichelten Linien sind horizontal, blau bei 0.163, orange bei 0.227 und grün bei 0.117. Eine Legende in der rechten oberen Ecke bezeichnet die durchgezogene blaue Linie als "w/o DPO obo", die durchgezogene orangene Linie als "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint", die durchgezogene grüne Linie als "DPO", die gestrichelte blaue Linie als "Average of w/o DPO obo", die gestrichelte orangene als "Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" und die gestrichelte grüne als "Average of DPO".

The line plot illustrates the average repetition rate across different relation categories, comparing three scenarios. The x-axis represents the relation categories, labeled as "Relation Category," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to roughly 60, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "Average Repetition Rate," also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.6 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The blue line with circular markers and a solid style represents "w/o DPO obo," beginning at approximately 0.25, peaking just above 0.6 near category 32, and ending around 0.1 and almost similar height near category 2. The orange line with triangular markers and a solid style denotes "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint," also starting just above 0.1, peaking at just below 0.6 near category 32, and finishing around 0.3. The green line, featuring square markers and a solid style, signifies "DPO," starting around 0.15, fluctuating slightly, with a peak at around 42nd category just above 0.2, and ending near 0.1. Each line exhibits variability with several peaks and troughs throughout the range of categories. Horizontal dashed lines indicate average values: 0.227 for the orange line, 0.163 for the blue line, and 0.117 for the green line. A legend is given top right describing the line and its color.

Линейният график илюстрира средната честота на повторение за различни категории отношения. Хоризонталната ос е означена като „Категория на отношенията“ и има линейна скала, варираща от 0 до 60 с отбелязани стойности на всеки 10 единици. Вертикалната ос е означена като „Средна честота на повторение“ и също има линейна скала, варираща от 0.0 до 0.6 със стъпка от 0.1. Графиката съдържа три основни линии. Първата линия е синя с кръгли маркери и плътен стил, представяща „без DPO obo“. Тя започва със средна честота на повторение малко над 0.25 при 0-та категория отношения, достига пикове около 0.6 при 1-вата и 31-вата категория, колебае се по оста и завършва около 0.3 при 64-тата категория. Втората линия е оранжева с триъгълни маркери и плътен стил, представяща „без DPO obo и без div-hint“. Тя започва около 0.16, достига най-висока стойност малко под 0.6 близо до 31-вата категория и завършва около 0.16 при 64-тата категория. Третата линия е зелена с квадратни маркери и плътен стил, показваща „DPO“. Тази линия започва около 0.163 и се колебае по оста, като достига максимум около 0.6 близо до 31-вата категория, а в края пада малко под 0.1. Освен това, има три хоризонтални прекъснати линии, представящи средни стойности: една оранжева при 0.227, една синя при 0.163 и една зелена при 0.117. Всички линии се пресичат на множество места. Легендата е разположена в горния ляв ъгъл и описва всяка линия и съответния ѝ цвят.
